search_text: published ZDI-15-015 ZDI-CAN-2534 Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Regions Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-02-10 CVE-2015-0027 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-0027 6.8 ['Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The vulnerability relates to how Internet Explorer performs layout of HTML pages. By manipulating a document's elements in a specific way on a page that uses CSS Regions, an attacker can force a Layout::PageFrameBox object in memory to be reused after it has been freed. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
